# pcd_identity_project (Data Source)

Look up a project (tenant) in PCD's Keystone identity service by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_identity_project" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Restrict the lookup to (and report) this domain.
- `name` (String) Look up the project by name.
- `project_id` (String) Look up the project by ID (takes precedence over name).
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The project description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the project is enabled.
- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `is_domain` (Boolean) Whether the project behaves as a domain.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent project ID.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the project.
